dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing originating from the mid-dorsal region and progressing to a sharp point at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a minor asymmetrical deviation (slight bulge) on the right side relative to the left, likely due to submerged pectoral limb positioning.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; localized greyish pigmentation clusters are visible on the cranial surface anterior to the blowhole.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp contrast gradient at the blowhole aperture; diffuse transitions between cranial grey patches and the depigmented white baseline.
